questions.question: An amount of Rs. 1,189 is to be divided among Rakesh, Mrinal and Sanjay in the ratio of 11 : 13 : 17, respectively. How much amount will Sanjay get more than Rakesh?
questions.solution:
Total amount = Rs. 1,189

Total amount divided among Rakesh, Mrinal, Sanjay is in ratio of = 11 : 13 : 17

Total amount divided into number of parts = 11 + 13 + 17 = 41 parts

∴ 41 parts = Rs. 1,189

⇒ 1 part = 1189 ÷ 41

⇒ 1 part = Rs. 29

Number of parts Sanjay received = 17 parts

Amount of Sanjay got = 17 × 29 = 493/-

Number of parts Rakesh received = 11 parts

Amount of Rakesh = 11 × 29 = 319

Amount of Sanjay got more than Rakesh = 493 - 319 = 174/-

Hence, the correct answer is **"174".**

questions.question:
Select the combination of letters that when sequentially placed in the blanks of the given series will complete the series.

L _ _ R _ T _ M P _ S _ _ M P _ S T

options.text: M, P, S, L, R, T, L, R
L, R, T, S, P, P, S, T
L, M, R, S, L, M, P, R
R, P, L, M, S, L, S, T

questions.solution:
Given:- L _ _ R _ T _ M P _ S _ _ M P _ S T

By checking options and substituting accordingly.

**1) M, P, S, L, R, T, L, R →** L **M P** R **S** T - **L** M P **R** S **T - L** M P **R** S T.

Here **"****L M P R S T" is repeated.**

2) L, R, T, S, P, P, S, T → L **L**** R** R **T** T - **S** M P **P** S **P - S** M P **T** S T

3) L, M, R, S, L, M, P, R → L **L** **M** R **R** T - **S** M P **L** S **M - P** M P **R** S T

4) R, P, L, M, S, L, S, T → L ** R**** P** R **L** - T **M** M P **S** S - **L S** M P **T** S T

 
• Option (1) gives pattern of : **L M P R S T** - L M P R S T - **L M P R S T.**

Hence, the correct answer is **"M, P, S, L, R, T, L, R".**

questions.question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. Some medicines are injections.

2. No injection is an equipment.

**Conclusions:**

I. No equipment is an injection.

II. No medicine is an equipment.
questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/063f11dbeb1cdf6049d08121383f449ed55b705b0b11bd25400fb17b78efe928.png] 

Conclusions:

I. No equipment is an injection → True (As No injection is an equipment so, No equipment is an injection is True)

II. No medicine is an equipment → False (As Some medicines are injections and No injection is an equipment so No medicine is an equipment is not a definite relation given hence, False)

∴ Here, Only conclusion I is true.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Only conclusion I follows".**

questions.question: ‘Majority’ is related to ‘Minority’ in the same way as ‘Natural’ is related to ‘________’.
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

Minority is antonym of Majority.

Similarly,

**'Artificial' is antonym of Natural.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Artificial".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

**Synonyms :**

⇒ Majority means more than half of people in a group

⇒ Minority means less than half of people in a group.

⇒ Natural means which is realistic.

**⇒ Artificial means which is not realistic i.e., fake.**

questions.question:
Which two signs should be interchanged to make the given equation correct?

12 - 14 × 21 ÷ 7 + 28 = 193
questions.solution:
By using BODMAS RULE :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3a84c2624712eb918bcca3c6fa1b16dca3d9cacbb6fc6d03a6c4e496059d1a05.png] 

Option 1) : × and -

Given equation is : 12 - 14 × 21 ÷ 7 + 28 = 193 

After interchanging the symbols the equation formed is : 

⇒ 12 × 14 - __**21 ÷ 7**__ + 28 = 193

⇒ __**12 × 14**__ - 3 + 28 = 193

⇒ __**168**__ - 3 __**+ 28**__ = 193

⇒ **__196 - 3__** = 193

**⇒ 193 = 193**

**LHS = RHS**

Option 2) : + and ×

Given equation is : 12 - 14 × 21 ÷ 7 + 28 = 193 

After interchanging the symbols the equation formed is : 

⇒ 12 - 14 + **__21 ÷ 7__** × 28 = 193

⇒ 12 - 14 + **__3 × 28__** = 193

⇒ __**12**__ - 14 **__+ 84__** = 193

⇒ **__96__****__ - 14__** = 193

⇒ 82 ≠ 193

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 3) : + and ÷

Given equation is : 12 - 14 × 21 ÷ 7 + 28 = 193 

After interchanging the symbols the equation formed is :

⇒ 12 - 14 × 21 + **__7 ÷ 28__** = 193

⇒ 12 - **__14 × 21__** + 0.25 = 193

⇒ __**12**__ - 294 **__+ 0.25__** = 193

⇒ **__12.25 - 294__** = 193

⇒ - 281.75 ≠ 193

LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) : × and ÷

Given equation is : 12 - 14 × 21 ÷ 7 + 28 = 193 

After interchanging the symbols the equation formed is : 

⇒ 12 - **__14 ÷ 21__** × 7 + 28 = 193

⇒ 12 - __**0.66 × 7**__ + 28 = 193

⇒ __**12**__ - 4.66 **__+ 28__** = 193

⇒ __**40**____** - 4.66**__ = 193

⇒ 35.33 ≠ 193

LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is **"× and -".**

questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

(9, 79, 7)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is :-

 
• **Second number = (First number × Third number) + (First number + Third number).**

 ♦ (9, 79, 7) → (9 × 7) + (9 + 7) = 63 + 16 = 79

Similarly,

** ♦ (15, 239, 14) → (15 × 14) + (15 + 14) = 210 + 29 = 239**

Hence, the correct answer is **"(15, 239, 14)".**
